prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic 9:16 European cafe lifestyle portrait at a lively Parisian terrace, preserving the supplied white tweed blazer, table setting and CARETTE context.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with natural facial features and hair as supplied, calm stylish expression and realistic skin texture. She wears a white tweed blazer with gold front and sleeve buttons, white cat-eye sunglasses resting on top of her head and a gold wristwatch. She holds a white coffee cup naturally with both hands.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 eye-level medium portrait. Seat the adult woman at an outdoor cafe table facing slightly toward camera. Include a white cup, silver teapot, glass of water, croissant, dessert cup with whipped cream and the supplied CARETTE plate/signage. Frame a busy terrace with seated patrons and classic Parisian buildings softly distinct in the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural afternoon daylight with realistic gentle shadows and highlights on tweed, buttons and tableware. Keep the atmosphere lively yet refined, with no artificial glamour filter.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical portrait, 50–85mm equivalent lens, moderate depth of field, sharp face and garment texture, softly blurred but recognizable background, high-resolution photorealism and natural color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 9:16 European cafe lifestyle portrait at a lively Parisian terrace of one original approved adult woman with natural facial features, realistic skin texture and a calm stylish expression. She wears a white tweed blazer with gold front and sleeve buttons, white cat-eye sunglasses resting on top of her head and a gold wristwatch, holding a white coffee cup naturally with both hands. Seat her at an outdoor cafe table facing slightly toward camera. Include a silver teapot, glass of water, croissant, dessert cup with whipped cream and the supplied CARETTE plate or signage. Show seated patrons and classic Parisian buildings in a softly distinct background. Use soft natural afternoon daylight, realistic shadows, detailed tweed and tableware, moderate depth of field and natural photorealistic color.
